scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w packages/api" "npm run dev -w packages/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/api && npm run typecheck -w packages/client
